---
name: Bug report
about: A tool returns a wrong result, an error, or the server is unreachable
title: "fix: "
labels: bug
---

**Which tool and arguments**
e.g. `convert` with `{ "amount": 100, "from": "EUR", "to": "USD", "date": "2026-10-22" }`

**What you got**
Paste the tool result or error message.

**What you expected**
If a rate looks wrong, include the value shown on https://bank.gov.ua for that date.

**Where**
- Client: claude.ai / Claude Desktop / mobile / Claude Code / MCP Inspector / other
- Server: local `npm start`, Docker, or your own host (version from `GET /`)
- Time of the request (with time zone), if it may matter

**Anything else**
